justification: Changes which rules the for-property route serves for every property: a predicate that ran in one layer now runs in all four. Wrong in one direction it hides rules that apply; wrong in the other it keeps serving rules for other zones. The tags it reads are already gated by DQ-115 (each declared zone carries the council's words).

falsifiable_check.command: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest -m database tests/test_provision_sql_filters.py -o addopts= && python -m pytest tests/test_provision_sql_filters.py -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The zone predicate is gated to one layer again (the source guard on route.ts), or it drops a row with no zone limit, an empty zone list or 'ALL', or keeps a row limited to other zones (real-Postgres VALUES cases).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Restoring `layer === 'use_specific' && filters.zone` in route.ts made test_the_route_checks_zone_in_every_layer print '1 failed'. The old predicate run against real Postgres drops the empty-list row (test_the_old_zone_predicate_dropped_undecided_rows).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Measured 2026-10-11 against production on the served-answer audit's 30 addresses (seed 20261011): 3,998 of 46,171 rules shown were tagged v2_applicable_zones excluding the lot's own zone from the NSW Planning Portal. Sampled rows checked by hand: Marrickville part6-industrial [E4], part5-commercial-mixed-use [E1,MU1], Leichhardt part-c-s4-non-residential [E1,E4,MU1] -- chapter-level limits matching each DCP's own structure.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions.v2_applicable_zones, 2,838 live+actionable rows limited to named zones outside the use_specific layer (marrickville 775, wollongong 584, campbelltown 561, leichhardt 463 ...). DQ-115 reads 0: every declared zone scope carries scope_evidence.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The route assumed only use_specific rows carry zone limits. In fact zone-limited chapters were loaded into the generic and precinct layers. council-config zoneFilterEffective looks like a switch but no code reads it.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing clause unchanged in meaning, moved to lib/provision-sql-filters.ts beside NOT_HERITAGE_SQL with the same read-the-string-and-run-it test pattern; adds only the empty-array keep.

functions.name: ZONE_APPLIES_SQL
functions.input: The $n index of the property's zone parameter, which the route binds to the Planning Portal zone code for the lot.
functions.output: A single-line SQL predicate keeping rows with no zone limit, an empty list, ALL, or the lot's zone listed.
functions.if_none: When the route has no zone for the property the predicate is not added at all, so nothing is withheld for want of a zone.

break_it.scenario: A zone tag is wrong (a residential chapter tagged E4 only).
break_it.what_happens: Its rules disappear for houses where they apply -- silent omission.
break_it.how: DQ-115 requires every declared zone scope to carry the council's own words; the sampled withheld chapters were read by hand and each is a chapter the DCP itself limits by zone. The served-answer audit re-run after deploy measures it on real addresses.

break_it.scenario: A row carries an empty zone array.
break_it.what_happens: The old string dropped it ('R2' = ANY('{}') is false).
break_it.how: cardinality(...) = 0 is kept; real-Postgres case 'empty zone list (undecided)'.
break_it.repro: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest -m database tests/test_provision_sql_filters.py -o addopts= -k zone

break_it.scenario: The property has no zone (Portal lookup failed).
break_it.what_happens: Withholding everything zone-limited would hide rules on a lookup failure.
break_it.how: The clause is only added when filters.zone is set -- same as before.

mutation_analysis: Forced: gating the clause back to use_specific turns the route source guard red. Dropping the cardinality term turns the empty-list case red. A predicate that returned TRUE would fail the 'industrial only' and 'commercial and mixed use only' cases; one that returned FALSE would fail the four keep cases.
residual_risk: The heritage-by-HCA path (queryHeritageByHca) returns before this clause and is not zone-checked; heritage rows limited by zone are rare and unmeasured here. Campbelltown's 'Zone R3 only' sections are tagged R2-R5 at chapter level, so this fix does not remove them -- section-level scope is a separate fix.

post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy: python scripts/served_answer_audit.py capture against a fresh run and confirm 50 Ruby St Marrickville no longer receives part6-industrial rules.
